skill.displayName: Pagrehistro ng PowPow — magrehistro ng Bula, i-pin ang talaarawan ng paglalakbay sa mapa, kausapin ang digital na tao

version.changelog: v2.1.0: Ang mga PayPal subscription ay pinamamahalaan na ngayon ng agent; nagdagdag ang scripts/powpow-register.mjs ng --provider alipay|paypal; na-update ang SKILL.md, payment-and-activation.md, agent-flow.md at README.md para sa mga paraan ng pagbabayad.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed PowPow account-registration and subscription helper; it handles sensitive signup and payment-adjacent data, but the behavior is coherent with its purpose and bounded to the official PowPow site.

dimensions.detail: Node execution, network access to https://global.powpow.online, optional local avatar-file reading, and opening generated checkout HTML are proportionate to agent-assisted registration and subscription activation, though users should understand those actions before proceeding.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is a normal skill install with a zero-dependency Node script; no package installation, remote code download, tool replacement, hooks, or automatic startup behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs agents to collect email, password, verification code, optional avatar path, and payment choices, but also states official-domain limits and tells agents not to handle payment-provider credentials. The listing overstates product-adjacent activities like travel diary/map/digital-human use, but the runtime instructions exclude posting or digital-human creation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The script stores temporary state including email, username, nickname, JWT token, and order identifiers in the OS temp directory with mode 0600 and provides cleanup; payment HTML is also written to a temporary directory for browser opening. No durable persistence, privilege escalation, or background service behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe PowPow registration, email verification, account activation, one-click login links, and Alipay/PayPal order creation/status checks; the script implements those flows without unrelated capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable letting the agent help create a PowPow account, send your registration details to the official PowPow domain, hold a temporary login token during the flow, and create/open a payment checkout page. Do not give the agent Alipay or PayPal credentials, and run the cleanup step when finished.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The scanner reported partial inspection of the referenced script, but the packaged script was present and fully inspected locally; no hidden remote payload or unanalyzable implementation was found.
[LP3] expected: The skill does require command execution, official-site network requests, environment-variable password passing, and limited local file access for avatars/screenshots. These are expected for the stated workflow, but explicit permission metadata would improve reviewability.
[SQP-2] expected: Collection and transmission of email, password, verification code, optional avatar, session token, and payment-order state are central to the registration flow and are repeatedly documented. Users should still treat this as sensitive account automation.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The listing title and keywords mention broader PowPow product experiences such as map travel diaries and digital-human chat, while the skill itself is limited to registration and activation. This is a metadata clarity issue, not evidence of hidden runtime behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The skill is published with language 'tl' and most user-facing guidance is in Filipino/Tagalog, with some Chinese and English strings inherited from platform/payment UI. This is a localization limitation rather than a security concern.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The screenshot reference includes GitHub/jsDelivr fallback URLs if bundled screenshots are missing. Because the screenshots are packaged locally, this is an unnecessary fallback and should stay secondary to local assets.
